criteria.unidentifiable: No specific supported leaf is justified by raw_text, price and merchant_type. This includes wholly unidentifiable lines and cases where only a parent is identifiable: this flat question has no parent-only answer. Do not guess a leaf from price, merchant type or typical product frequency. Do not use this for an identifiable item outside every supported parent; use out_of_scope.
criteria.out_of_scope: The item or adjustment is identifiable but no supported parent applies, such as an electronic cable, clothing or an ordinary merchandise return. Do not use this merely because a supported parent's particular leaf is unknown; choose unidentifiable for insufficient leaf-level information.
